theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n M θ ξ → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫⁻ y in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) * ‖ξ y - ξ x‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) / (∫⁻ y in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
